blocks.html: Where only a forward approach is provided to the water closet, the clearance shall be 66 inches (1676 mm) minimum, measured perpendicular from the rear wall, and 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum, measured perpendicular from the side wall. A lavatory complying with Section 1107.2.2.5 shall be permitted on the rear wall, 18 inches (457.2 mm) minimum from the water closet centerline.
